verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that Workers lets developers build and deploy serverless functions and full-stack apps on Cloudflare's global network with no servers to manage, across many frameworks and languages, using Wrangler deploy commands. A hands-on community report describes getting an API into production within an hour. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of full-stack framework app deployment (community notes no full Node runtime and CPU-time limits)

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy serverless functions and full-stack apps with no servers to manage

citations.quote: Build and deploy serverless functions and full-stack apps on Cloudflare's global network. No servers to manage.
Build full-stack apps with your framework of choice, including React, Vue, Svelte, Next, Astro, React Router, and more
The core Wrangler commands for creating, developing, and deploying Workers are on the Workers commands page.
In an hour the API was running in production
